basics.name: Jim Leirvik
basics.label: Senior Systems Engineer / Fullstack Developer
basics.summary:
Senior systems engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, building, and evolving business-critical software across backend, frontend, and platform domains.

I focus on system architecture, operational reliability, and improving how software supports real-world workflows—particularly in complex, integrated, or regulated environments.

Across my career I’ve consistently worked on platform modernization, workflow automation, system integration, and quality improvements. My strength lies in shaping how systems are structured and operated, not just delivering isolated features.

Hands-on across Java, Kotlin, Python, PHP, Node.js, React, TypeScript, Angular, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and Azure DevOps, with experience in API integration, CI/CD, and test automation.

highlights: Led the design and rollout of a Django-based platform, defining architecture, development structure, and workflows for scalable delivery across teams.
Contributed to backend modernization efforts, introducing Kotlin as the preferred language for new and incremental backend development alongside existing Java services.
Developed and maintained Java backend services and Angular frontends for business-critical and regulated systems, focusing on stability, maintainability, and operational reliability.
Owned the technical design and implementation of a core subsystem within the company’s self-onboarding initiative: a form builder used to define onboarding workflows across divisions.

Designed and implemented a form builder supporting conditional logic (e.g. dynamic resource creation based on user input), reusable components, and cross-division sharing of configurations, replacing manual processes previously handled by operations teams.
Contributed to ISO-related quality and security processes through documentation, testing practices, and system improvements supporting audit readiness and reliability.
Built internal tooling that reduced manual workload and improved operational support workflows.
Collaborated across disciplines to align technical solutions with real operational requirements in a healthcare-related environment.
Supported CI/CD and release pipelines using Azure DevOps, including build automation and deployment workflows.
